name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Stormwind, human priests seek a prayer for their own hour of need. At the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena teaches acolytes to call on the Holy Light when their lives are at risk.

sections.title: A Plea in the Dark
sections.body: Priests in the Cathedral of Light learn to use their faith to shield companions, heal wounds, and strike at evil. Yet even the devout can be isolated, cornered, or brought close to death. In such moments, an acolyte may cry out to the Holy Light for help, with their own survival at stake.

sections.title: The Cathedral's Blessing
sections.body: High Priestess Laurena guides clergy in Stormwind's Cathedral Square and judges when an acolyte is ready for deeper teachings. Human initiates who show devotion to the Light across the kingdom receive this lesson as both protection and a charge to continue serving the realm.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer lets a wounded priest call on the Holy Light to heal their own critical injuries at once, without a long chant.

faq.q: Who grants this lesson in Stormwind?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena grants this lesson in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral Square, once an acolyte has shown devotion and experience in the wider world.

faq.q: Why do priests receive this specific teaching?
aliases: why do priests get desperate prayer
faq.answer: Priests of the Holy Light risk their lives to aid others. This prayer can help preserve a healer's life when they are alone or badly hurt.

faq.q: Can any adventurer learn Desperate Prayer here?
faq.answer: No. Only priests devoted to the Holy Light and guided by the Church of the Light receive this lesson.

faq.q: Where does this rite take place?
faq.answer: The rite takes place in the Cathedral of Light, in the northern district of Stormwind City.

faq.q: Is Desperate Prayer unique to human priests?
aliases: do other races get desperate prayer
faq.answer: Both human and dwarven clergy in Alliance lands have access to Desperate Prayer, through their closely allied traditions of worshiping the Holy Light in Stormwind and Ironforge.

angles.text: As a priest, this rite marks your passage from apprentice acolyte to an active servant of the Holy Light, prepared to survive deadly trials in the field.
As a human, you receive this teaching from the Cathedral of Light's clergy, affirming Stormwind's place as the foremost seat of human faith.
As a member of the Alliance, you know that blessings like Desperate Prayer help keep frontline healers alive to tend soldiers on dangerous frontiers.
